label: D2 after a1 -> S1 (common), only in the last ~8 trials of the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass) when the input shows state S1 (100%) reached after choosing a1 (99.4%; a2->S1 rare is nearly silent), and only at the very end of the episode: 99.8% of mass is in trials 90-99 and none before trial 80. It also sits entirely in the lowest value bin (value < 5.22), which is the end-of-episode value drop. Magnitude ramps up over consecutive late a1->S1 trials (e.g. 0.5 -> 0.7 -> 0.8 -> 0.9 -> 1.0 across a window) and so tracks how close the episode is to its end. Reward, transition history and the good state matter little beyond this. Never fires at D1/GO, on S2, or before trial ~90. Precision is only about 0.5: many late-episode a1->S1c D2 steps stay silent, mostly the earliest ones in the 90s, so the onset is not a sharp trial cutoff. The value < 5.22 version scores about the same (dev F1 0.63). All variables used are observed at D2 (the episode clock is implicit).
